g.title: push
g.text: git push — the SECOND way work leaves the machine
There is no submit moment: .provenance/ IS the submission,
no seal step ever runs, and the ROLLING seal is its only seal.
Per-session filenames keep a shared directory add-only
a rolling seal per session, rewritten on
EVERY checkpoint — so whatever is committed
is always a valid seal of that moment

g.title: compose
g.text: IN THE BROWSER. The course private key is read
inside the sign handler and dropped on return —
never state, never a request, never storage.
every session after this is offline
